items.html: And behold, these 72 and 216 emerge from the Name of Havayah itself, their root, which is in gematria 26, and this Name is in the Tifferet. And 72 is in Hesed, and 216 is in Gevura. And the totality of these three aspects, which are 72, 216, and 26, which are in the HGT, are in gematria Shaddai. And as explained by us in the intention of the thirteen attributes and 'Va-ya'avor', etc. See there, for there it is well explained.
